description: S'mores are a sweet treat you make by roasting marshmallows over a campfire, then putting them with chocolate between two graham crackers. They are gooey and delicious. People love making s'mores when they sit around a campfire.

A faker is someone or something that pretends to be something else. Imagine if a marshmallow looked real but was actually made of plastic—that would be a fake marshmallow. Fakers trick others into believing they are real when they're not.
